posts.title: Mavericks-Rockets preview: Irving's debut takes center stage
posts.author: Eddie Sefko
posts.summary: Kyrie Irving has been waiting, patiently, for what seems like an eternity.
facts: The long-awaited moment is finally expected to happen Sunday in China.
And while it is “only” the preseason, it is part of the NBA China Games 2026 and will command global attention.
After more than 18 months of recovery from surgery to repair his torn left ACL, Irving will take the court at the Venetian Arena against the Houston Rockets.
And his return is being anticipated by everybody in the NBA, including one of the other superstars in China — Houston’s Kevin Durant.
Durant missed the 2019-20 season with a ruptured Achilles.
His teammate, point guard Fred VanVleet, returned Friday in China after missing last season because of an ACL tear.
And for superstars returning from a season-long injury, it’s even tougher.

posts.title: New Orleans Pelicans sign Jalon Moore, waive Christian Koloko
posts.author: Pelicans.com
posts.summary: The New Orleans Pelicans announced today that the team has signed forward Jalon Moore. Per team policy, terms of the deal were not disclosed.
facts: Moore, 6-7, 215, who suffered a torn Achilles tendon prior to the 2025 NBA Draft, played in three games for the Pelicans Summer League team in Las Vegas this past summer, averaging 6.0 points and 4.0 rebounds in 19.3 min…
As a college senior, Moore appeared in 34 games (all starts) for the Oklahoma Sooners during the 2024-25 season, finishing with averages of 15.9 points and 5.8 rebounds in 30.3 minutes per game.

Moore appeared in a total of 110 games (81 starts) over four collegiate seasons with Georgia Tech (2021-23) and Oklahoma (2023-25), holding career averages of 10.6 points and 5.3 rebounds in 23.5 minutes per contest.
In a corresponding move, the team has waived center Christian Koloko.

posts.title: Grizzlies Defeat Bulls 104–100 in Chicago
posts.author: Memphis Grizzlies
posts.summary: CHICAGO, Ill. - The Memphis Grizzlies (2-1) defeated the Chicago Bulls (1-1) 104100 Friday at United Center.
facts: CHICAGO, Ill. - The Memphis Grizzlies (2-1) defeated the Chicago Bulls (1-1) 104100 Friday at United Center.
Ty Jerome led the Grizzlies in scoring with 16 points on 5-for-8 shooting from the field and 4for-6 shooting from three-point range.
GG Jackson II added 14 points on 5-for-9 shooting with four rebounds, one assist and one block in 17 minutes off the bench.
Cameron Boozer and Zach Edey both finished with 10 points.
Rookie Caleb Wilson led the Bulls with 21 points, four rebounds and one steal in a team-high 32 minutes.
Norman Powell finished with 17 points, three rebounds, two assists and one steal in 19 minutes.
Leonard Miller added 12 points and 11 rebounds in 23 minutes off the bench for his first double-double of the preseason.
Memphis limited Chicago to just 37.5% from the field and 35.3% from deep and outpaced the Bulls in fast break points (17-8) and points in the paint (50-34).
